acceptance: A forced chunk failure on QuestDB REST fails the load, with the chunk named in the error.
A forced Databend count mismatch fails the load, and the table is truncated or the failure says it is partial.
Live checks against both engines are recorded.
description:
Leftovers from the load-path fixes in #3981. (1) QuestDB's REST /imp path still swallows per-chunk load failures, unlike the ILP path, which now fails on any count mismatch. (2) Databend detects a row-count mismatch only after COPY INTO has run, so a partial load stays in the table until the next run recreates the schema. Both must fail loudly and leave no silently partial data.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree; live checks under mocker through make heavy-run (see uat-mocker-compose-gaps-20261106); no explanatory comments; changelog fragment.
